tasks.goal: In shard_plan.py, plan(tests, shards, pinned=None, max_per_shard=None) splits CI tests across shards. tests maps test name -> duration in seconds. shards must be an int >= 1, else ValueError. pinned maps test name -> shard index (0-based); a pinned name that is not in tests, or an index outside 0..shards-1, raises ValueError. Pinned tests are placed first. Every other test is then placed greedily in order of duration descending, ties by name ascending, onto the shard with the smallest current total, ties going to the lowest index; with max_per_shard set, a shard holding that many tests is skipped, and if a test fits nowhere (or a pin overfills a shard) raise ValueError. Return one dict per shard in index order: {"tests": sorted names, "total": total duration rounded to 3 decimals}.

files.shard_plan.py:
def plan(tests, shards, pinned=None, max_per_shard=None):
    out = [{"tests": [], "total": 0} for _ in range(shards)]
    for i, (name, dur) in enumerate(tests.items()):
        s = out[i % shards]
        s["tests"].append(name)
        s["total"] += dur
    return out

tasks.goal: In junit_merge.py, merge(runs) combines CI attempts of the same suite: runs is a list (attempt 1, 2, ...) of lists of cases {name, status, optional time}; status is one of passed, failed, error, skipped (anything else raises ValueError). For each test name (sorted ascending in the result) look at its statuses in attempt order: if the last one is passed and an earlier one was failed or error the verdict is 'flaky'; if the last one is skipped but an earlier attempt passed the verdict is 'passed'; otherwise the verdict is the last status. A test missing from a later attempt keeps its earlier results. Return {"tests": {name: {"verdict", "attempts" (how many attempts reported it), "time" (sum, rounded to 3 decimals)}}, "summary": counts for passed, flaky, failed, error and skipped (all five keys always present), "time": total of all times rounded to 3 decimals}.
